# MacroSidekick

> MacroSidekick is a voice-first AI food log and contextual nutrition coach for general wellness. It is a real iPhone beta distributed through Apple TestFlight.

Canonical site: https://macrosidekick.com/
Editorial index: https://macrosidekick.com/blog
Beta access: https://macrosidekick.com/#beta
Privacy: https://api.macrosidekick.com/privacy
Support: https://api.macrosidekick.com/support

## Product facts

- The public signup currently requests and sends iPhone TestFlight access. It is not a vague waitlist.
- Meal input supports natural speech, text, and up to four photos.
- Users review an editable ingredient-level nutrition estimate before saving.
- Users can correct the entire meal by voice or text.
- The Sidekick coach can use the user's plan, history, recipes, preferences, and remaining macros.
- The coach can take actions such as logging meals and saving recipes.
- Public launch pricing has not been announced.

## Limits and safety

- MacroSidekick supports general wellness and does not provide medical advice.
- Photo and AI meal estimates are not exact. Results vary with visible ingredients, preparation, image quality, portions, and user context.
- MacroSidekick does not duplicate MacroFactor's adaptive expenditure algorithm.
- Comparisons are published by MacroSidekick and link to first-party competitor sources.
